releases.title: Initial Mission Control baseline
releases.summary: Introduced the local GBrain-backed task interface with Today, Inbox, Upcoming, Blocked, Projects, Goals, Completed, Quick Add, and verified task details.

releases.title: Reliable task workflow and Board
releases.summary: Added status editing, the task Board, and reciprocal goal links; normalized lifecycle relationships so every valid task stays visible exactly once without hidden-task issues.

releases.title: Next actions and automatic refresh
releases.summary: Added verified Next Action editing in task details and a visible read-only refresh every 30 minutes that coalesces requests, defers while hidden, and resumes when the page is visible.

releases.title: Durable projects and faster reads
releases.summary: Added verified GBrain project creation, persistent zero-task project cards, separate task assignment, and bounded parallel reads to reduce task-loading latency.

releases.title: Immediate verified status updates
releases.summary: Status changes now reconcile from canonical GBrain readback immediately; Board adds keyboard/touch movement and silent same-status no-ops. Projects are now limited to typed members of Tony's Projects, with first-use initialization and visible malformed-member diagnostics.

releases.title: Goal lifecycle controls and steadier reads
releases.summary: Added verified goal creation plus confirmed Pause and recoverable Delete workflows that preserve linked task content; capped GBrain read concurrency and coalesced duplicate initial loads while manual and automatic Refresh remain authoritative.

releases.title: Inbox-centered warning controls
releases.summary: Centralized task, project, goal, and relationship warnings in Inbox; added confirmed durable dismissal, restart-safe preferences, changed-issue reappearance, and a recoverable dismissed-warning list without hiding canonical data.

releases.title: Privacy-safe operational Logs
releases.summary: Added a read-only Logs dialog beside About with newest-first filtering and pagination, fixed-message Event Queue Reader history and health, bounded redacted Mission Control events, and graceful queue-unavailable status that never blocks core task workflows.

releases.title: Optional task progress and safe duplication
releases.summary: Full task creation can track an optional count metric with a clear preview, cards and details show verified progress, and Duplicate provides a reviewable clean copy with progress, evidence, receipts, and completion history reset. The job-applied binding uses the exact daily five-application contract and completes only after five distinct accepted events.

releases.title: Agent profiles and optional Board work
releases.summary: Agent Work now shows Toddy, Timmy, and Tammy with typed default-goal ownership and safe profile links. Board remains Tony-only by default; Show agent tasks reads the three canonical agent collections on demand, adds accessible owner and avatar badges, and keeps agent work visibly read-only and separate from Tony’s obligations.

releases.title: Agent proposal review
releases.summary: Inbox now shows canonical agent proposals grouped by Toddy, Timmy, and Tammy, distinguishes work proposed for Tony from proposed agent work, and provides explicit review, approval, and rejection flows with durable GBrain relationships and exact readback; empty state creates no suggestions.

releases.title: Explicit agent task assignment
releases.summary: Full Create Task now defaults to Tony but can create one verified queued work item for Toddy, Timmy, or Tammy with exact typed collection membership and assigned_to ownership, no duplicate Tony task or proposal; agent cards retain owner avatars and support authoritative status updates.

releases.title: One full Create Task flow
releases.summary: Removed the reduced Quick Add interface. Create Task is now the only visible task-creation action in the sidebar and at the top of Today and Inbox; all three open the same full form with due date, assignee, project, goal, and optional metric support, and the N shortcut opens that full form.

releases.title: Unified task editing
releases.summary: Task details are now read-only until Edit opens one full form for task fields, status, project, associated goal, optional metric, and assignee. Saves use canonical GBrain readback; agent handoffs retain the same task and a durable assignment history.

releases.title: Mission Control, avatars, and simpler navigation
releases.summary: GTasks is now visibly Mission Control while preserving its local service and GBrain identity. Agent profiles can safely upload a verified avatar through local Memory Stargraph storage, while cards retain accessible text names and initials fallback. The sidebar is now text-first and Upcoming has been removed as a redundant top-level view; future tasks remain canonical and available through their details, projects, and goals.

releases.title: Safer agents and goal ownership
releases.summary: Avatar upload now validates the exact selected Agent Directory slug and typed agent page before sending any image to Memory Stargraph. Validated local previews render immediately with an accessible file name and clear safely after cancellation, failure, or verified upload. Agent Profiles can assign or unassign default goals through the same verified GBrain relationship shown in Goal details.

releases.title: Reliable agent avatar identity
releases.summary: Agent avatars now preserve each profile’s canonical Agent identity after Memory Stargraph attachment verification, so avatar changes cannot make Toddy, Timmy, or Tammy disappear from Agent Work.

releases.title: Tony avatar on Board
releases.summary: Board cards for Tony’s personal tasks now display Tony’s canonical GBrain profile avatar, with a safe initials fallback if the profile image is unavailable.

releases.title: Reliable Agent Work rendering
releases.summary: Fixed Agent Work and Proposed Tasks to use the shared owner/avatar renderer, preventing a JavaScript exception that left the previous view visible after navigation; added regression coverage for both agent surfaces.
